function: Joint device transmit weights and server receive beamforming for analog over-the-air gradient aggregation in FL, minimizing total device transmit power subject to FL convergence conditions (pp. 3-5).
system: Uplink analog OTA FL: 10 single-antenna devices, server with 16 antennas, 100 kHz bandwidth, COST Hata path loss, no RIS; carrier frequency not stated (pp. 3, 9).
method: FedSGD training of logistic regression (MNIST) and ResNet14 (CIFAR-10); transceiver by non-learned alternating optimization with convex QP/QCQP subproblems, no neural beamformer (pp. 3, 6, 10).
data_channel: Synthetic channels: complex Gaussian h ~ CN(0, I/PL), COST Hata path loss, device distance 10-100 m, constant during training; MNIST and CIFAR-10 as learning data (p. 9).
test_conditions: Averages over 20 channel realizations; sweeps of power limit P0 (15-27 dBm) and CSI error (0-0.2); MNIST and CIFAR-10 trained separately (pp. 10-11).
baselines: MMSE and Bounded MSE power minimization (both defined by the authors, non-learned) and GSDS [21], an earlier published over-the-air aggregation design with beamforming and device selection (p. 9).
metrics: Time-averaged sum device transmit power (dBm) at the same target test accuracy (85% MNIST, 70% CIFAR-10); epochs to reach the target (pp. 10-11, Figs. 2-7).
complexity: Order O((M+N)^3) per communication round for the proposed algorithm, from QP subproblems of O(M^3) and O((M+N)^3); same with estimated CSI (pp. 7, 9).
openness: none; MNIST and CIFAR-10 are public learning datasets, channels are synthetic, no code link (p. 9).
q1_support: p. 9: "path loss follows the COST Hata model [35]" and the channel is "generated using a complex Gaussian distribution". Custom Gaussian fading with only the path loss from COST Hata; no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data.
q2_support: p. 10: "All results are averaged over 20 channel realizations" and "We consider P0 in the range of 15 dBm to 27 dBm"; p. 11: CSI-error sweep (Figs. 6-7). Only power-limit and CSI-error sweeps; no new scenario, dataset, device count or antenna count is tested.
q3_support: p. 9: "Greedy Spatial Device Selection (GSDS) [21]" (earlier published aggregation design) and "Minimum Mean Square Error (MMSE)" (non-learned reference); p. 10: "PoMFL reduces the total power consumption by more than 25 dB compared to Bounded MSE and more than 35 dB compared to GSDS and MMSE".
q4_support: p. 7: "overall computational complexity of our proposed algorithm" is O((M+N)^3) per communication round; p. 9 repeats it for estimated CSI. This is the cost of the transceiver design, not of the FL model.
q5_support: p. 9: "image classification, where we consider the training the logistic regression for MNIST [33]" and CIFAR-10 [34] are learning-task datasets only; the channels are synthetic (p. 9) and no code or data link appears.
notes: Included under area 7: the paper designs the over-the-air aggregation itself (transmit weights and receive beamforming); the learned element is the FL model, so no_learning does not apply. q3 follows the FL over-the-air rule: GSDS [21] is an earlier published design by the same authors, MMSE and Bounded MSE are self-defined non-learned references; reviewer to confirm. q1 is 0 because only the path loss follows COST Hata (not COST 2100) and fading is complex Gaussian. PDF is the arXiv v1 preprint; its title matches the Crossref title of the DOI.
